title: Do not reject my judgment; dragon bound like a sparrow
english: Loss of child, property, or health cannot touch us unless God judges. Do not reject my judgment means: do not deny what I decided about you in this speaking. Do you think I dealt with you for any end but that you might appear righteous? You were righteous but hidden; endurance and courage needed the pains to shine them out. In distress we should hear God saying the trial was allowed so that righteousness would be plain to those who did not know it.

Take up height: the victor is to take power, be crowned, and put on beauty. The insolent campaigner is humbled and sent off in shame with his ranks. Chapter 41 asks whether one will play with the dragon as with a bird or bind him like a sparrow for a child. For a finished soul Satan is handed over bound, unable to hurt, led where the child wills — by the Lords grace.

title: Nations feed on the dragon; eyes like Morning Star
english: By grace Satan is bound for infants and nursing ones, from whose mouth God prepared praise. Nations feed on him: as the Lord feeds the faithful, the dragon feeds the impious — [[food for the Ethiopians >> Bible:Psalm 74:14]] read as sons of darkness. Every word we take is either empty hearing from the dragon or a building word from Christ.

No fleet of human bodies can by itself strip even one hide from his tail; only under divine oversight is he finished. He is folded; the holy can expose the fold, and to the holy he is not folded. Spirit will not pass him means nothing escapes him — all must come through. Prepare not to be seized. His eyes have the look of the Morning Star — not that they are that star.

title: False light of heresy; the Lord gave double
english: His eyes only look like the Morning Star: he transforms himself into an angel of light and pretends to be a day-sign. Burning lamps name the dragons mouth — introducers of godless doctrines. Under Christian pretext, Marcionite, Valentinian, or Basilidean speech that attacks the Maker of heaven and earth sends out firebrands. Keep yourselves lest those lamps burn you.

One who after ruin takes the dragon in again receives into the soul a creature filled with evils. Chapter 42: the Lord gave double. The one who has stood every trial receives endurance-prizes doubled — and the Lord gives even a hundredfold. Double restoration answers double virtue shown.
